title: [Main]-Incident 21000001049308 : [BC-IN] Purchase invoice with a deferral schedule and Non-availment GST is not functioning correctly
summary: A purchase invoice with Non-availment GST can now be posted when a default deferral template is configured on the G/L account, by handling the deferral validation for India localization in the tax engine.
key_points: Fixed posting failure for purchase invoices with Non-availment GST and deferral schedules
Subscribed to OnBeforeCheckDeferralConditionForGenJournal event for India tax handling
Resolves related journal voucher posting issues caused by the same validation
Changes only affect India localization in the tax base application
quote: A purchase invoice with Non-availment GST does not get posted when a Default Deferral Template is configured
